QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] The Pendant is Key
QuestInfo.0: Aoe is surprised that godly powers weren't the answer. Talk to him again.
QuestInfo.1: Aoe suspects that the pendant Noctis passed down from generation to generation is the key. Defeat #bSoul Slayers#k in Fate-Fields of Providence to find the pendant.
QuestInfo.2: You found the pendant. Take it to Sieg and use it on the chest.

default.0: Find the pendant. That will be the key.
